description: This file defines the BackupSearchClient class for interacting with AWS Backup Search service, including method definitions for various backup search operations with their async counterparts.

classes.name: BackupSearchClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Backup Search service, inheriting behavior from the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: getSearchJob
methods.description: Retrieves a search job based on provided arguments.

methods.name: getSearchJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a search job.

methods.name: getSearchResultExportJob
methods.description: Gets a search result export job.

methods.name: getSearchResultExportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets a search result export job.

methods.name: listSearchJobBackups
methods.description: Lists backups for a search job.

methods.name: listSearchJobBackupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists backups for a search job.

methods.name: listSearchJobResults
methods.description: Lists results for a search job.

methods.name: listSearchJobResultsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists search job results.

methods.name: listSearchJobs
methods.description: Lists search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchJobsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists search jobs.

methods.name: listSearchResultExportJobs
methods.description: Lists export jobs of search results.

methods.name: listSearchResultExportJobsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists export jobs for search results.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: startSearchJob
methods.description: Starts a search job.

methods.name: startSearchJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a search job.

methods.name: startSearchResultExportJob
methods.description: Starts a search result export job.

methods.name: startSearchResultExportJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a search result export job.

methods.name: stopSearchJob
methods.description: Stops a search job.

methods.name: stopSearchJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops a search job.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
